info.title: AI Citizen Assistant API
info.description: Welfare-scheme eligibility for Madhya Pradesh and central schemes. Eligibility is decided only by a deterministic rule engine; every profile value carries its provenance.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: 200 when PostgreSQL is reachable and the rule engine is loaded and synced; 503 otherwise. Optional services (Neo4j, Ollama, knowledge graph, RAG index) are reported but never fail readiness.

get.summary: Profile field catalog for the UI

delete.summary: Hard-delete a citizen and all their data
delete.description: Deletes the profile, document metadata, evaluations and enrollments (database cascade). An audit row without personal data is kept.

patch.description: Changed values become `self_declared` (a correction of an OCR value loses its document provenance); re-submitting the stored value keeps its provenance; `null` clears a field.

schema.title: Response List Enrollments Api V1 Citizens  Citizen Id  Enrollments Get

put.summary: Record (self-declared) enrollment status for a scheme

post.summary: Upload a certificate (PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF) and apply OCR-extracted values
post.description: The file is processed in memory and not stored; its type is sniffed from the bytes (the client Content-Type is ignored). Valid values with confidence >= the OCR review threshold (0.80) and no OCR notes become `document_extracted`; others are returned in `review_required` (with their value when only a soft note applies, null when validation failed); values that differ from what the citizen entered are returned in `conflicts` and not applied. When the declared `document_type` contradicts the detected content, nothing is applied and `type_mismatch` is true. Uploading the same file again returns the existing document with status 200 and `duplicate: true` (no OCR re-run, nothing applied).

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Citizens  Citizen Id  Documents Get

delete.summary: Delete a document and the profile values still sourced from it
delete.description: Values still sourced from the document are removed (`removed_profile_fields`), except values the citizen had self-declared identically before the upload confirmed them: those revert to `self_declared` (`reverted_profile_fields`). Values the citizen corrected are untouched.

get.summary: List schemes with benefit and verification status

schema.title: Response List Schemes Api V1 Schemes Get

get.description: Conditions, official sources, required documents, limitations and application steps.

post.summary: Evaluate a stored citizen against all effective schemes
post.description: Runs the rule engine on the stored profile, persists one evaluation per scheme with condition-level results in a single transaction, and returns them grouped by status.

get.summary: Most recent persisted evaluation run, with staleness
get.description: Returned as stored (never recomputed). `stale` is true when the stored profile (values, provenance or OCR confidence) or the rules in effect today differ from what the run used; `stale_reasons` lists `profile_changed` / `rule_version_changed`. POST a new evaluation to refresh.

post.summary: Stateless evaluation of a supplied profile
post.description: Nothing is stored; the response is always marked `simulation: true`. Each field carries its own provenance (`self_declared` or `document_extracted`) and optional OCR confidence. `verified` cannot be claimed by a caller (422 `provenance_not_allowed`). `document_extracted` is accepted for what-if checks but is client-asserted (no document backs it): those fields are listed in `client_asserted_provenance` with an explanatory `provenance_note`.

get.summary: Unclaimed benefits, next steps, document gaps and complementary schemes
get.description: Built from a persisted evaluation run that matches the current profile (values, provenance, OCR confidence) and the rules in effect today: the latest run is reused while it is fresh, otherwise a new run is evaluated and persisted first (older runs are kept). `evaluated_now`, `stale_reasons`, `run_id` and `evaluations` (evaluation id + rule version per scheme) say which run was used. Enrollments are read live: schemes marked enrolled or applied are treated as already claimed. `graph_source` says whether complementary schemes came from Neo4j or the identical in-memory fallback.

parameters.name: refresh

schema.description: Evaluate and persist a new run first.
schema.title: Refresh

parameters.description: Evaluate and persist a new run first.

post.summary: Explain the citizen's eligibility decision for a scheme, with citations
post.description: Uses the latest persisted evaluation run while it matches the stored profile and the rules in effect today; otherwise (or if none exists) a new run is evaluated and persisted first (`evaluated_now`, `stale_reasons`). `decision` is always the rule-engine status of `evaluation_id`; the answer cites official documents.

post.summary: Evaluate a supplied profile for one scheme and explain it (nothing persisted)
post.description: Same profile rules as POST /eligibility/evaluate: `verified` provenance is rejected (422 provenance_not_allowed) and the response is marked `simulation: true`.

post.summary: General question about a scheme, answered from its official documents
post.description: No personal decision (`decision` is null); off-topic or injection attempts are refused.

get.summary: One district with its blocks and per-scheme coverage

previous_provenance.description: Provenance before this upload; null if absent.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: The [n] marker used in the answer.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional non-identifying label, e.g. 'Synthetic demo: rural student'. Never a real name or ID.

is_synthetic.title: Is Synthetic
is_synthetic.description: True for demo / test records (all data today).

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Persisted evaluation run the recommendations are based on.

evaluated_now.title: Evaluated Now
evaluated_now.description: True when this request had to run (and persist) a new evaluation.

stale_reasons.title: Stale Reasons
stale_reasons.description: Why the previous run could not be reused (it is kept in the history); empty when the latest run was still fresh, none existed, or refresh=true.

profile_fingerprint.title: Profile Fingerprint
profile_fingerprint.description: Profile fingerprint of the run used (matches the profile).

rule_set_hash.title: Rule Set Hash
rule_set_hash.description: Rule-set identity of the run used (matches the loaded rules).

evaluations.title: Evaluations
evaluations.description: Exact persisted evaluation and rule version used for each scheme.

profile_changed_since_evaluation.title: Profile Changed Since Evaluation
profile_changed_since_evaluation.description: Deprecated, always false: stale runs are now re-evaluated automatically.

removed_profile_fields.title: Removed Profile Fields
removed_profile_fields.description: Profile values that were still sourced from it.

reverted_profile_fields.title: Reverted Profile Fields
reverted_profile_fields.description: Values the citizen had self-declared identically before this document confirmed them; kept and reverted to self_declared.

original_filename.title: Original Filename
original_filename.description: Sanitized basename; identity-number-like digit runs masked.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: Detected from the file's magic bytes, not the client header.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.description: True when this exact file was already uploaded for the citizen.

type_mismatch.title: Type Mismatch
type_mismatch.description: The declared document_type contradicts the detected content: nothing was applied and every field is in review_required (warnings carry declared_type_mismatch:<declared>!=<detected>).

review_required.title: Review Required
review_required.description: Values needing confirmation (low confidence, OCR notes, type mismatch) or that failed validation (value null), kept on the document until the user confirms them via PATCH profile.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.description: Values that differ from what the user entered (or a verified value); not applied.

id.title: Id
id.description: Persisted evaluation id; null for stateless evaluations.

verification_warning.title: Verification Warning
verification_warning.description: Rule-engine warning for partially verified / unverified rules (null when verified); show it next to the status.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Evaluate rules effective on this date (default: today).

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Shared id of the persisted run; null for stateless evaluations.

profile_fingerprint.title: Profile Fingerprint
profile_fingerprint.description: sha256 of every profile value + provenance + confidence the run read (no timestamps); null for runs stored before fingerprints existed.

rule_set_hash.title: Rule Set Hash
rule_set_hash.description: sha256 of the effective rule versions + engine confidence threshold used.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: GET .../evaluations/latest only: the stored run no longer matches the current profile or the rules in effect today.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.description: True for stateless evaluations: caller-supplied data, nothing stored.

client_asserted_provenance.title: Client Asserted Provenance
client_asserted_provenance.description: Stateless only: fields the caller marked document_extracted without any uploaded document behind them.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Rule-engine status (null for general Q&A); never set by the LLM.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: ollama | gemini | none (extractive / refusal, no LLM text).

evaluated_now.title: Evaluated Now
evaluated_now.description: Citizen endpoint: true when a new evaluation had to be run and persisted first (none existed, or the latest one was stale).

stale_reasons.title: Stale Reasons
stale_reasons.description: Citizen endpoint: why the previous run could not be reused (it is kept).

profile_fingerprint.title: Profile Fingerprint
profile_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the profile the decision was evaluated on.

rule_set_hash.title: Rule Set Hash
rule_set_hash.description: Rule-set identity of the run used (citizen endpoint).

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.description: True for POST /explain: caller-supplied profile, nothing stored.

client_asserted_provenance.title: Client Asserted Provenance
client_asserted_provenance.description: POST /explain: fields the caller marked document_extracted without a document.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when the text was found but failed validation.

citizens.title: Citizens
citizens.description: Eligible or potentially eligible, not enrolled citizens lacking it.

missing_fields.title: Missing Fields
missing_fields.description: Catalog fields with no value yet, in catalog order.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Field name -> new value (validated against GET /profile-fields); null clears the field. Values entered here are recorded as self_declared.

provenance.description: self_declared or document_extracted (client-asserted; the response is marked `simulation`). `verified` is rejected with 422 provenance_not_allowed.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a profile value came from. Never conflate document text with verification.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when validation failed; confirm or correct via PATCH profile.

id.title: Id
id.description: Persisted evaluation id; null for stateless evaluations.

verification_warning.title: Verification Warning
verification_warning.description: Rule-engine warning for partially verified / unverified rules (null when verified); show it next to the status.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Field name -> value with provenance. Validated against GET /profile-fields.
